parse.title: Low Level Alchemy
parse.wikitext:
==Cost==
The [[Explorer's ring 1]] can be used to cast Low Level Alchemy up to 30 times per day without requiring any runes; however, no experience is granted.

It is possible to cast this spell at the Fountain of Rune, requiring no runes, resulting in greater profit, however no experience is granted. Like most activities in the [[Wilderness]], this is attempted at one's own risk.

{{Spell cost table
|Rune1 = fire
|Rune1num = 3
|Rune2 = nature
|Rune2num = 1
